def process(mmc1, hyperactivated) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    clin = mmc1.copy()

    # Find histology column
    hist_col = None
    for c in clin.columns:
        cl = c.strip().lower()
        if cl in {'histologic_type', 'histologic type'}:
            hist_col = c
            break
    if hist_col is None:
        cand = [c for c in clin.columns if 'histologic' in c.lower() and 'type' in c.lower()]
        hist_col = cand[0] if cand else None
    if hist_col is None:
        return pd.DataFrame([{
            'error': 'Histologic type column not found',
            'available_columns_sample': ', '.join(list(clin.columns)[:60])
        }])

    # Find CNV subtype column (TCGA)
    cnv_col = None
    # prefer any column containing both 'cnv' and 'subtype'/'cluster'
    pref = [c for c in clin.columns if 'cnv' in c.lower() and (('subtype' in c.lower()) or ('cluster' in c.lower()))]
    if pref:
        cnv_col = pref[0]
    else:
        # fallback: any column containing 'cnv'
        cand = [c for c in clin.columns if 'cnv' in c.lower()]
        cnv_col = cand[0] if cand else None

    if cnv_col is None:
        return pd.DataFrame([{
            'error': 'CNV subtype column not found',
            'histologic_type_col': hist_col,
            'available_cnv_like_columns': ', '.join([c for c in clin.columns if 'cnv' in c.lower()][:30]),
        }])

    clin[hist_col] = clin[hist_col].astype(str).str.strip()
    clin[cnv_col] = clin[cnv_col].astype(str).str.strip()

    endo = clin[clin[hist_col].str.contains('Endometrioid', case=False, na=False)].copy()

    # CNV-high labels vary (CNV-high, CNV high, High)
    cnvhigh = endo[endo[cnv_col].str.contains('cnv', case=False, na=False) & endo[cnv_col].str.contains('high', case=False, na=False)]
    if cnvhigh.empty:
        cnvhigh = endo[endo[cnv_col].str.contains('high', case=False, na=False)]

    # Determine sample id column for linking to hyperactivated.sample_id
    sid_col = None
    for c in ['idx', 'Proteomics_Participant_ID', 'Sample.ID', 'Sample_ID', 'sample_id']:
        if c in cnvhigh.columns:
            sid_col = c
            break
    if sid_col is None:
        # fallback: any column containing 'idx' or 'participant'
        cand = [c for c in cnvhigh.columns if c.lower() in {'idx'} or 'participant' in c.lower()]
        sid_col = cand[0] if cand else None

    if sid_col is None:
        return pd.DataFrame([{
            'error': 'Sample ID column not found',
            'histologic_type_col': hist_col,
            'cnv_col': cnv_col,
            'rows_endometrioid': int(endo.shape[0]),
            'cnv_col_value_examples': '; '.join(list(endo[cnv_col].dropna().astype(str).unique()[:10]))
        }])

    sample_ids = set(cnvhigh[sid_col].astype(str).str.strip())

    ha = hyperactivated.copy()
    ha['sample_id'] = ha['sample_id'].astype(str).str.strip()
    ha['protein'] = ha['protein'].astype(str).str.strip()

    out = ha[ha['sample_id'].isin(sample_ids)][['protein']].drop_duplicates().sort_values('protein').reset_index(drop=True)
    out = out.rename(columns={'protein': 'gene_name'})

    # If empty, return diagnostics to help pinpoint the mismatch
    if out.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame([{
            'error': 'No hyperactivated proteins matched CNV-high endometrioid sample IDs',
            'histologic_type_col': hist_col,
            'cnv_col': cnv_col,
            'sid_col': sid_col,
            'rows_total': int(clin.shape[0]),
            'rows_endometrioid': int(endo.shape[0]),
            'rows_cnvhigh_endometrioid': int(cnvhigh.shape[0]),
            'example_cnv_col_values_endometrioid': '; '.join(list(endo[cnv_col].dropna().astype(str).unique()[:10])),
            'example_sample_ids_cnvhigh': '; '.join(list(sorted(sample_ids))[:10]),
            'example_sample_ids_hyperactivated': '; '.join(list(sorted(set(ha['sample_id'].unique())))[:10]),

        if cl in {'histologic_type', 'histologic type'}:

    if hist_col is None:
        cand = [c for c in clin.columns if 'histologic' in c.lower() and 'type' in c.lower()]
        hist_col = cand[0] if cand else None

    # CNV subtype class
    cnv_col = None
    # Prefer explicit class/subtype columns
    preferred = [c for c in clin.columns if 'cnv' in c.lower() and any(k in c.lower() for k in ['class', 'subtype', 'cluster', 'group'])]
    if preferred:
        # Prefer something like CNV_class exactly
        preferred_sorted = sorted(preferred, key=lambda x: (0 if x.strip().lower() == 'cnv_class' else 1, len(x)))
        cnv_col = preferred_sorted[0]
    else:
        # Fallback: any CNV column
        cnv_cols = [c for c in clin.columns if 'cnv' in c.lower()]
        cnv_col = cnv_cols[0] if cnv_cols else None

    # sample id column
    sid_col = None
    for c in ['idx', 'sample_id', 'Sample_ID', 'Proteomics_Participant_ID', 'Proteomics_Aliquot_ID']:
        if c in clin.columns:
            sid_col = c
            break

    if hist_col is None or cnv_col is None or sid_col is None:

            'cnv_col': cnv_col,
            'sid_col': sid_col,
            'n_cols': clin.shape[1]
        }])

    # ---- filter to CNV-high endometrioid ----

    cnv_series = endo[cnv_col].astype(str).str.strip()

    cnvhigh_mask = cnv_series.str.contains('cnv', case=False, na=False) & cnv_series.str.contains('high', case=False, na=False)
    # some files use just 'HIGH'
    if int(cnvhigh_mask.sum()) == 0:
        cnvhigh_mask = cnv_series.str.contains('high', case=False, na=False)

    endo_cnvhigh = endo[cnvhigh_mask].copy()
